summary: Reviewed 3 files (src/server/routes/workspaces.ts, src/server/index.ts, src/orchestration/vscode-workspace.ts). QA note about path traversal risk on URL-derived params was investigated thoroughly. 0 Critical, 0 High findings. Path traversal is prevented by two independent layers: (1) storage-registry lookup requires the ID to already exist as a validated project/workspace key (projectId validated via isValidKebabCase → /^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/, workspaceId validated via isValidWorkspaceId → /^[A-Z]{2,6}$/), and (2) extractParams does not URL-decode, so encoded traversal sequences are passed as opaque strings that fail registry lookup. repoId values come from project.Repositories (trusted storage, not direct user input). 1 Low finding recorded. Security sign-off: PASS.

comments.note: A01/A05 — Low: Error responses for 404 cases echo the user-supplied projectId and workspaceId verbatim (e.g. 'Project ".." not found.'). For a single-user local tool this is acceptable and consistent with the existing codebase style. In a future multi-tenant deployment this could assist enumeration. Recommendation: return a generic 'Not found.' message without echoing the supplied identifier when the surface becomes multi-user.

A09 — Info: No specific audit log entry is recorded when generateWorkspaceFile() completes successfully on the new endpoint. The ErrorLogManager captures failures via the router's unhandled-rejection handler, but successful file-write operations are silent. For the current single-user CLI context this is acceptable. Recommendation: add a structured success event log if this endpoint is exposed to a shared/multi-user environment.

Path traversal investigation (A01/A03) — CLEAN: QA flagged fs.existsSync and path.join usage with URL-derived params. Confirmed safe via dual-layer validation: (1) projectId must match a stored project key (isValidKebabCase enforces /^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/), (2) workspaceId must match a stored workspace key (isValidWorkspaceId enforces /^[A-Z]{2,6}$/), (3) extractParams does not URL-decode raw segments so encoded traversal sequences (%2F, %2e) are inert as storage keys, (4) repoId values in repoPaths come exclusively from project.Repositories (trusted storage, not request input). No path traversal vector exists.
